Responsibilities Director of Music, Art & Recreation Therapies (M.A.R.T.) Valley Hospital is a 122-bed private psychiatric hospital specializing in mental health and substance use treatment. Our approach is built on three core principles: outstanding care, compassionate people, and unparalleled service. Our multidisciplinary team is committed to providing effective, individualized treatment that supports recovery, wellness, and improved quality of life. We combine evidence-based clinical practices with comprehensive behavioral health services to help our patients achieve meaningful and lasting progress. Valley Hospital is seeking an experienced and passionate Director of Music, Art & Recreation Therapies (M.A.R.T.) to provide leadership and strategic direction for our therapeutic programming. The Director of M.A.R.T. is responsible for overseeing the development, implementation, and ongoing effectiveness of music, art, recreation, and related therapeutic services throughout the hospital. This leader will ensure programs meet the clinical needs of our patients while supporting the hospital’s overall goals for quality, safety, patient experience, and therapeutic engagement. We are looking for a collaborative and creative leader who is passionate about behavioral health and understands the important role therapeutic activities play in patient recovery. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership skills, clinical judgment, organization, and the ability to build meaningful programs that engage patients and support positive outcomes. Join Valley Hospital and help create therapeutic experiences that make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients we serve. Qualifications Requirements: Bachelor's Degree required, Master's Degree is preferred Related work experience 3-5 years Certification or Licensure - Art, Occupational, Recreation or Music Therapy A working knowledge of behavioral health management practices and clinical operations. An advanced knowledge of state and federal regulatory and various accreditation requirements related to behavioral health management. Avoid and Report Recruitment Scams We are aware of a scam whereby imposters are posing as Recruiters from UHS, and our subsidiary hospitals and facilities. Beware of anyone requesting financial or personal information. At UHS and all our subsidiaries, our Human Resources departments and recruiters are here to help prospective candidates by matching skill set and experience with the best possible career path at UHS and our subsidiaries. During the recruitment process, no recruiter or employee will request financial or personal information (e.g., Social Security Number, credit card or bank information, etc.) from you via email. Our recruiters will not email you from a public webmail client like Hotmail, Gmail, Yahoo Mail, etc. If you suspect a fraudulent job posting or job-related email mentioning UHS or its subsidiaries, we encourage you to report such concerns to appropriate law enforcement. We encourage you to refer to legitimate UHS and UHS subsidiary career websites to verify job opportunities and not rely on unsolicited calls from recruiters.
